issues.description: Element: Aufgabe 02 expected result type. The problem statement (problem_statement.md) asks for a single aggregated value: the number of Gemeinden in Regierungsbezirk 'Oberbayern' (i.e. a COUNT result). The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe02.sql) instead selects all rows for that Regierungsbezirk (SELECT * FROM Gemeinde WHERE regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern'), returning multiple rows and full columns rather than a single numeric aggregate. The template (template_repository/aufgabe02.sql) is empty. This mismatch between the problem requirement (an aggregated COUNT) and the provided solution query (row list) will confuse students about the expected output shape and grading (they will expect/count a single numeric result but the solution returns many rows).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution return a single aggregated value to match the task. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gemeinde WHERE regierungsbezirk = 'Oberbayern'; Alternatively, if the intent was to list all Gemeinden, update the problem statement to request the list instead of the count.
